name: Cervical Discitis
definition: Infection involving a cervical intervertebral disc and adjacent endplates, with risk of epidural extension, instability and spinal cord compression.

investigations.principle: Contrast MRI is the key imaging study; blood cultures and inflammatory markers support diagnosis.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, inflammatory, infection, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Surgery is considered for instability, abscess, progressive deficit or failed medical treatment.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Any Shotha/Asthi-Majja framework is secondary to modern infection management.

patientEducation.summary: Infection involving a cervical intervertebral disc and adjacent endplates, with risk of epidural extension, instability and spinal cord compression.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
